description: This file defines the VersionAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving the current version of the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods for fetching the version information and stubs for update, delete, and validation methods that are not yet implemented.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class that provides the current version of OrangeHRM. Implements methods to retrieve version info, with other modify/delete operations unimplemented.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Returns the current API version encapsulated in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne request, excluding the 'id' parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; intended to handle updates to the resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; intended to validate update requests.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; intended for deleting the resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a 'not implemented' exception; validation for delete requests.
